name: Lewis B. Puller
summary: Battalion commander whose reputation was made on the night of 24–25 October 1942, when 1st Battalion, 7th Marines held about a thousand yards of the Guadalcanal perimeter against repeated regimental attacks by the Sendai Division and did not give way. Five Navy Crosses across three wars, the most awarded to any Marine, and the Corps' most quoted officer — which makes him a useful test of the difference between what a man did and what was later said about him.
